name: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164, Subpart C)
version: Security Rule technical and administrative safeguards
notes: Infrastructure-relevant subset of the Security Rule safeguards for systems handling ePHI. Physical safeguards for cloud data centers are typically inherited from the cloud provider under a BAA. Not legal advice.

requirements.name: Access control
requirements.description: Technical policies and procedures that allow access to ePHI only to authorized persons or software programs.
infra_signals: IAM least privilege on ePHI stores
private subnets and endpoint policies for data services

requirements.name: Encryption and decryption (addressable)
requirements.description: Mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI at rest.
infra_signals: encryption at rest with customer-managed keys

requirements.name: Audit controls
requirements.description: Hardware, software, and procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems containing ePHI.
infra_signals: CloudTrail / Activity Log / Audit Logs enabled on all accounts
log retention >= 6 years for policy artifacts

requirements.name: Integrity
requirements.description: Policies and procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.
infra_signals: object versioning / soft delete on ePHI storage

requirements.name: Person or entity authentication
requirements.description: Procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.
infra_signals: no static credentials in code or pipelines

requirements.name: Transmission security
requirements.description: Technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI transmitted over a network.
infra_signals: VPN or private peering for backend traffic
HTTPS-only policies on storage and APIs

requirements.name: Risk analysis
requirements.description: Accurate and thorough assessment of potential risks and vulnerabilities to ePHI.
infra_signals: security posture service (Security Hub, Defender for Cloud, SCC)

requirements.name: Contingency plan
requirements.description: Policies for responding to an emergency that damages systems containing ePHI (backup, disaster recovery, emergency mode).
infra_signals: multi-AZ or multi-region failover for critical ePHI systems

requirements.name: Information access management
requirements.description: Policies for authorizing access to ePHI consistent with the minimum necessary standard.

requirements.name: Business associate contracts
requirements.description: Contracts with business associates (including cloud providers) that safeguard ePHI.
infra_signals: cloud provider BAA in place (organizational; only HIPAA-eligible services used in the stack)
